description: Send an advertiser application: an offer you want publishers to promote on a CPL/CPA/CPS/RevShare basis. Use the applicant's real details and only with their consent. Our team answers by email. Returns a reference.

agent_name.description: If you are an AI agent applying on someone's behalf: your name/product, e.g. 'Claude for Acme Media'

email.description: Email where we send the answer (and the login, for publishers)

name.description: Full name of the person applying

offer.description: What you want to promote: product/brand and offer type

payout.description: Payout and model, e.g. '$25 CPL' or '40% RevShare'

telegram.description: Telegram handle, if any (our account managers work on Telegram)

tracker.description: Your tracking platform: Everflow, Hitpath, Cake, other

name: apply_as_advertiser
title: Apply as an advertiser
